title: Free Issue Closing QA
eyebrow: QA · one short test for you

short.lead: The close guard now lets the agent close issues labelled needs review, in review or completed by someone else, with no milestone, and asks you about everything else. I tested it against the real GitHub; your test is one prompt in a session on the branch build.
short.hint: Tap a step to see what to do.
items: RESULT: PASS - all 1321 checks passed, exit 0, including 25 new checks for the lookup, the label rule and Close approved.

#548 (in progress) refused; #520 and #521 (needs review) allowed; closing milestone 1 refused. 4 of 4 both runs. The first close read GitHub in 1.1 seconds, the next ones used the saved answer in 0.1 seconds. Nothing was closed.
Session test could not sign in

Headless Claude Code sessions started inside this cloud sandbox cannot sign in ("Not logged in", and "Authentication error" for a one-line session), so the agent-closes-#520 test did not run. Nothing on GitHub changed. Script and result: docs/plans/2026-11-20-free-issue-closing-live-tests/.
Ask a branch session to close a reviewed issue

In a Claude Code session running the branch build (python tools/use_branch.py AjsAgent/free-issue-closing on your PC, then a new session in this repo), type: Close issue #520 if the house rules allow it. Expect it to close #520 without asking you, comment the evidence and add AjsAgent completed this. Then type: Close issue #548. Expect a refusal saying it is labelled in progress, or needs review, and how to approve it.

changes: Label rule, one cached GitHub read, Close approved, milestone guard.
A not-planned close still needs a sweep approval, "Close as not planned" or "Close approved"; the label rule applies to completed closes only.
rules/house-rules.md, rule 6 in issue-workflow.md, docs/4-systems/issue-closing.md, CHANGELOG.md, plugin 2.83.0. Pull request #553 is already open.
Pull request #553 to main, body says Refs #548 to #552.

unverified: An agent actually closing #520 and labelling it: headless sessions cannot sign in inside this cloud sandbox, and this session's installed 2.82.0 guard refuses the close, which I will not get around.

wrapup.summary: The agent closes reviewed or completed issues on its own; milestone issues, milestones and everything else wait for your Close approved.
wrapup.changing: The close guard, its checks, the rule text and the issue-closing docs, in pull request #553.
wrapup.next: Run your test, then send "QA passed: free issue closing" or "QA failed: free issue closing" with what went wrong.
